# proxmox_node_services (Data Source)

Lists the known system services of one node from `/nodes/{node}/services`, sorted by service name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_services" "node1" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `active_state` (String)
- `desc` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `service` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `unit_state` (String)
